features.spotify_cloud_independent_reverify: Cloud/remote Spotify execution always takes an independent fresh computer_observe verification instead of blindly trusting bridge verified_playback claims.
features.spotify_evidence_reporting: Verified playback messages report query-matching evidence before generic now-playing candidates.
features.spotify_exact_token_truth: Spotify search and now-playing verification use whole normalized query tokens; short queries such as 'maa' cannot match Maanu, Maand, or Maahi by substring.

hotfixes.cloud_thread_context: Direct cloud chat uses request-scoped cloud thread history instead of leaking recent messages from another cloud thread.
hotfixes.cloud_turn_retry_deduplication: Web Remote-authorization continuation reuses one turn_id so retrying the same user turn cannot duplicate cloud transcript entries.
hotfixes.cross_device_message_sync: Web and Android poll the active cloud workspace and merge only unseen persisted message IDs.
hotfixes.florence_remote_code_cache: setup pre-caches microsoft/Florence-2-base-ft remote implementation used by the icon-caption model config
hotfixes.local_device_bridge_contract: shared request metadata accepted locally; remote-session provenance remains rejected
hotfixes.omniparser_dependencies: headless runtime excludes conflicting demo/cloud/dev packages
hotfixes.omniparser_empty_ocr_guard: full visual parse survives icon-only/low-text screenshots affected by upstream empty-OCR None iteration
hotfixes.omniparser_extras_filter: headless dependency filter now excludes extras forms such as anthropic[bedrock,vertex] as well as bare package names
hotfixes.omniparser_full_device_control: IRAS full parser now constructs YOLO/Florence on the configured device instead of upstream auto-CUDA selection; unsupported legacy CUDA capability falls back to CPU
hotfixes.omniparser_full_diagnostics: vision status exposes full model state/device/warmup/error and setup prints HTTP failure detail
hotfixes.omniparser_openai_import: Managed OmniParser retains the minimal openai==1.3.5 package required by upstream imports while excluding cloud/demo stacks and making no cloud model calls.
hotfixes.omniparser_optional_cleanup: PowerShell 5.1 stderr warnings from optional pip-uninstall cleanup no longer abort setup; native exit code is handled explicitly
hotfixes.omniparser_ownership: Windows persisted PID probing hardened for cross-process managed ownership
hotfixes.omniparser_repair_weights: repair reuses live detector/Florence assets in place instead of deleting memory-mapped model.safetensors
hotfixes.quick_code_deterministic_execution: Simple VS Code/code-generation requests use one specialized verified file workflow: choose an allowed workspace, write source directly, read it back byte-for-byte, open VS Code, and terminate without generic GUI planner loops.
hotfixes.quick_code_vscode_followup: Quick Code remembers the most recently verified source artifact so follow-ups such as 'try this in VS Code' run that exact file in VS Code's integrated terminal without another model/planner loop; Python scripts that clearly request input receive a bounded sample value for the try/run action.
hotfixes.risk_based_local_approvals: routine local Spotify/media/WhatsApp-open/scroll actions auto-run at SAFE_ACTION; consequential actions retain approval; remote classification unchanged
hotfixes.spotify_error_toast_rejection: Spotify can't-play-this-right-now/local-file toast is detected as a hard failure and IRAS retries another query-matched candidate instead of accepting Pause state.
hotfixes.spotify_fastpath: device_spotify_play local CLI path no longer raises unexpected remote_session_id TypeError
hotfixes.spotify_now_playing_truth: Playback verification scopes query evidence to the right now-playing panel/bottom transport metadata so library/search text cannot validate an unrelated active track.
hotfixes.spotify_pause_truth: A connected Spotify device or successful shortcut is not considered playback; IRAS fails closed when the visible transport remains Play/paused.
hotfixes.spotify_query_bound_playback: Query playback uses Spotify search URI first, ranks multiple semantic results, retries candidates, and activates only result-bound UIA/content Play controls; global Space/media-resume and unanchored green-button fallbacks are forbidden.
hotfixes.spotify_quick_search_overlay: After selecting a semantic result, IRAS detects and dismisses Spotify Quick Search before touching content playback controls so the Chromium overlay cannot intercept the Play action.
hotfixes.spotify_semantic_result_selection: Spotify no longer treats Shift+Enter as playback proof; it selects a query-matched UIA result, uses semantic/content Play with visual fallback, and requires visible playing state before success.
hotfixes.spotify_semantic_verification: after Play, IRAS reads Spotify UIA state and only marks playback verified when Pause state and query-related evidence are visible
hotfixes.spotify_startup_sequencing: Spotify play now uses open/focus -> visual readiness -> search -> search readiness -> play with URI/green-button fallbacks
hotfixes.spotify_uia_invoke: Content Play prefers the existing audited Windows UI Automation InvokePattern/LegacyIAccessible default action, then scoped mouse/Space fallbacks, with visible playing-state verification after every attempt.
hotfixes.unified_cloud_workspace: Windows cloud client, web/PWA and Android share persistent cloud thread/history/client presence without moving local device-control enforcement into the public server.

release_name: RC12 Persistent Goal Continuity + Cross-Platform Voice Reliability
release_notes: Unified cloud workspace shared across Windows, web and Android clients.
Professional adaptive UI/UX and motion system across web/PWA, Windows desktop and Android.
Viewport-locked chat workspace keeps the composer visible while history scrolls internally.
Safe local Markdown renderer adds professional headings, lists, inline code and collapsible/copyable code blocks without external UI libraries.
User-supplied IRAS logo is packaged across web/PWA, Windows desktop and Android branding.
Full PC + Cloud + Web + Android operating guide is packaged at docs/RUN_IRAS_FULL_STACK.md.
Owner-controlled Master Control provides bounded CRITICAL registered-tool authority with local-only activation and emergency-stop/audit preservation.
Web, Android and the Windows cloud client can attach ephemeral FULL Master Remote sessions only after the PC is locally armed.
Master-enabled local multi-agent workers can use the full registered tool surface; normal background workers remain READ-capped.
Emergency Master execution replaces ordinary small workflow/task budgets with a high-capacity adaptive profile while local Master Control or a verified master Remote session is active.
Master owner-intent policy does not stop merely for complexity, length, cost, repetition or recoverable tool failures; it continues until verified completion or a concrete blocker.
A configurable runaway watchdog remains so a broken provider/tool loop cannot execute forever; emergency stop, authentication, OS/UAC and safety/security boundaries remain non-bypassable.
Quick Code follow-up context remembers the last verified source file and can run it directly inside VS Code's integrated terminal.
Cloud AI Agent now extends provider failover to the paired Windows PC's Ollama after the configured cloud provider pool is exhausted or rate-limited.
Cloud Spotify execution takes an OmniParser-backed second visual observation when a legacy/unverified bridge response lacks playback proof, and rejects unrelated playback.
Windows cloud client exposes /agent status for cloud-agent routing, device Ollama fallback readiness and deterministic executor visibility.

Coding Agent project resolution now honors explicit Windows paths, fuzzy project names, root-over-artifact ranking, fail-closed ambiguity, remembered follow-up selection, and /code projects/use/status/pause/resume/cancel/diff controls.
Dedicated Web Research Agent adds /research run/status/pause/resume/cancel with read-only public-web evidence collection, cross-checking and review.

Permissioned Software Installer Agent adds /install search/run/url/status/pause/resume/cancel; WinGet exact-ID is preferred and direct web installers require public HTTPS, SHA-256 continuity and valid Authenticode.
Software installation remains CRITICAL and requires authenticated Remote authority plus laptop-local allow_shell; emergency stop, audit and Windows/UAC remain non-bypassable.
Coding/Installer orchestration no longer marks explicit permission/device blockers as successful and requires a verified COMPLETE coordinator outcome.
Clean-tree validation excludes legitimate .venv contents, fixing false failures caused by dependency __pycache__ files.
RC5 extends the Software Installer into a permissioned Software Lifecycle Agent with read-only update discovery, exact-package update, explicit update-all, uninstall, and post-action verification.

Software update/uninstall are CRITICAL Remote actions and require laptop-local allow_shell; fixed argv shell=False execution, emergency stop, audit, Remote Protocol 1, and Windows/UAC remain enforced.
RC12 adds a restart-safe Goal Continuity Ledger: resume decisions are evidence/freshness-aware, every meaningful action remains verification-bound, and side effects are never replayed automatically.
